rule: A strategy enters only after every engine gate EG0-EG9 passes and at least one family gate passes
why_this_rule: An entry that fails a gate would publish a claim the data cannot support
what_is_intentionally_left_blank: Nothing; the gate list is fixed

rule: Rank on a pre-declared, timestamp-locked probability metric, reported with an interval, not on total winnings
why_this_rule: Total winnings rewards stake size and variance and cannot distinguish skill from luck
what_is_intentionally_left_blank: The metric name and its definition

rule: Report the interval with every rank; do not order entries whose intervals overlap
why_this_rule: Ordering overlapping entries invents a difference the sample cannot support

rule: Show eligible N next to every entry and suppress entries below the pre-declared minimum
why_this_rule: A rank built on a handful of events is noise

rule: Publish the number of strategies attempted next to the winners
why_this_rule: The best of many attempts needs a discount

rule: Every entry is shown against an explicit no-skill benchmark computed the same way
why_this_rule: A score means nothing without the benchmark it must beat

rule: No licensed price or third-party dataset is republished on the leaderboard
why_this_rule: Redistribution may breach the licence even when use is allowed

rule: No reward is offered, promised or described until EG16 passes
why_this_rule: A reward for a gambling-adjacent contest may be unlawful in the user's jurisdiction

rule: A strategy that fails persistence twice is marked retired and keeps its history
why_this_rule: Deleting failures would make the record selective

rule: Public entries are lagged and labelled research; nothing on this site is a live pick
why_this_rule: A published live pick becomes advice and inherits liability and rights problems

rule: Each entry links to the committed code, inputs, seed and preregistration
why_this_rule: An unreproducible entry cannot be audited

rule: The ranking metric may not be changed mid-competition; a new metric starts a new season
why_this_rule: Changing the metric after results is a way to manufacture a winner
